answer_sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.country_name = 'Germany' THEN s.net_amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.net_amount), 0),
    2
  ) AS percentage_of_total_net_revenue
FROM contoso_served.v_contoso5_sales_line AS s
JOIN contoso_served.dim_store AS st
  ON s.store_key = st.store_key
JOIN contoso_served.dim_country AS c
  ON st.country_code = c.country_code
WHERE
  st.is_online = FALSE
